BRIDGE:KBP410.selection_note: Since 2026-09-23 the grinder stage is sized for 3 A, close to the 3.4 A RMS a stalled 68 ohm winding draws at 230 V. 4 A covers that current, but at 3 A the bridge dissipates about 5 W against 55 C/W to ambient, so it is rated for intermittent grinding only (one grind of up to 10 s, then a pause); a larger GBU does not fit between the barrier and JP19. If the measured running current exceeds 1.5 A, or GR-06 shows more than 100 C on the case, it moves to four discrete diodes. Replaces the earlier GBU8K placeholder. The KiCad KBPM footprint has a 3.85 mm pitch, inside the datasheet's 3.56-4.06 mm.

Kept for the record; the board model fails if it returns to a mains branch. Owner's fuse for the grinder (2026-09-23), resized to T4A when the stage moved from an assumed 1 A to 3 A: a 3 A run loads it to 75 %, where a T2A would sit at 150 %. It rides through the 3.4 A start and clears a shorted bridge or winding, but a 3.4 A stall is only 85 % of its rating and never blows it; the stall is the firmware's to cut. Breaking capacity is 50 A at 250 V, low for a mains branch; F701 upstream remains the main protection. Same footprint as the T2A (JFC2410-1200TS, C136382) it replaces.

FUSE:0215004.MXEP.stock_evidence: JLCPCB component list API (selectSmtComponentList), read-only; ratings from the Littelfuse 215 Series datasheet (revised 01/12/17), Electrical Characteristic Specifications by Item
FUSE:0215004.MXEP.selection_note: Replaces the JDT JFC2410-1400TS (50 A at 250 V) on 2026-10-06, issue #1: a shorted BR701 diode puts the mains across the bridge through Q708, and F703, the smallest fuse in that loop, is the one that has to break it. Axial-lead version (0.65 mm leads, 5.5 x 21.5 mm body), mounted on end beside Q708: the only free spot near the grinder path is 4.6 mm wide, too small for a horizontal 5 x 20 mm body. Littelfuse asks for at least 1.5 mm between board and cap and the lead bend at least 1.0 mm from the cap; the returning lead is sleeved. Not for reflow: hand or wave soldered. Its nominal melting I2t (46.96 A2s) is above the KBP410 I2t rating (35 A2s), so it does not demonstrate that the bridge survives a short on the DC side.

Main fuse F701 since 2026-10-06 (issue #1): the 10 A rating it had, now with a stated 1500 A breaking capacity. Holder: two Littelfuse 111 501 spring-brass clips (01110501Z, LCSC C151075, 5132 in stock on 2026-10-06), which the Littelfuse clip catalogue rates "for current levels up to 10 amperes". FUSE:0215012.MXEP.selection_note: Main fuse F701 since 2026-10-06 (issue #1). The original HD8911 board has a ceramic 5 x 20 mm fuse marked 12AH250V in F1 (owner, read on the part he removed), so the maker gave the same heater 12 A. A 10 A fuse in 10 A clips left no margin over the 8.4 A (230 V) to 9.2 A (253 V) heater current, and 12 A is above what the Littelfuse 111 501 clips take, so it is soldered flat with axial leads like the original F1, over 27.5 mm holes. It keeps the 1500 A at 250 VAC breaking capacity and raises the nominal melting I2t ratio to F703 from 7.1 to 11. Not for reflow: hand or wave soldered.
